## Frequently asked questions

Where is ACT located?

ACT is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, and has 14 [locations][74] worlwide. Our interactive map
shows you all locations and their contact details. So you can reach us at any time.

Which raw materials does ACT distribute?

We have been your reliable partner for high-quality ingredients for four decades. As a Hamburg
company, we offer quality raw materials for food, feed, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and technical
applications.

[Follow this link][75] to get an overview of the different sectors that we supply with our quality
raw materials.

How can I be sure that the products meet the specific quality?

Our long-term partnerships build on our consistently high quality and customer satisfaction. Our
internal [quality][76] management department continuously checks the approval of suppliers and raw
materials. We work with independent test laboratories to ensure meaningful monitoring.

Is ACT a certified distributor for quality raw materials?

Yes, ACT is certified in multiple categories and can always deliver the best possible quality. For a
full list and download links to our certifications please visit our [quality ][77]page.

# 
# Multinational manufacturer and distributor
# of biocides, disinfectant products, flame retardants,
# personal care ingredients and other speciality chemicals.

## Welcome to ACTI-CHEM SA

Acti-Chem’s roots in South Africa were firmly entrenched 40 years ago, providing innovative and
technologically advanced chemicals to local industries and customers abroad. Often unseen by their
users, Acti-Chem products can be found in a variety of industries from newspapers to cosmetics, from
building and construction to high fashion.

** Supported by an ongoing commitment to research and development, ACTI-CHEM's activities centre on
the production and supply of a wide range of biocides, disinfectant products, flame retardants and
personal care ingredients.**

[[Biocides]][54] [BIOCIDES][55]

ACTI-CHEM has a wide range of **ACTICIDE^{®}** biocides  for the safe and effective preservation of
a multitude of industrial and consumer products.

[[Disinfectants]][56] [DISINFECTION][57]

ACTI-CHEM is a leading producer of **ACTICIDE^{®}** disinfectant actives based on quaternary
ammonium compounds for diverse markets and applications.

[[Flame Retardants]][58] [FLAME
RETARDANTS][59]

ACTI-CHEM is an established name in the development and production of **AFLAMMIT^{®}**
environmentally acceptable flame retardant products.

[[Personal Care]][60] [PERSONAL
CARE][61]

ACTI-CHEM's **Microcare^{®}** range includes high purity preservatives and emollients, globally
approved quat and amine conditioning products and silicones for skin and hair care.

## Welcome to ACTI-CHEM SA

Acti-Chem’s roots in South Africa were firmly entrenched 40 years ago, providing innovative and
technologically advanced chemicals to local industries and customers abroad. Often unseen by their
users, Acti-Chem products can be found in a variety of industries from newspapers to cosmetics, from
building and construction to high fashion.

** Supported by an ongoing commitment to research and development, ACTI-CHEM's activities centre on
the production and supply of a wide range of biocides, disinfectant products, flame retardants and
personal care ingredients.**

[[Biocides]][54] [BIOCIDES][55]

ACTI-CHEM has a wide range of **ACTICIDE^{®}** biocides  for the safe and effective preservation of
a multitude of industrial and consumer products.

[[Disinfectants]][56] [DISINFECTION][57]

ACTI-CHEM is a leading producer of **ACTICIDE^{®}** disinfectant actives based on quaternary
ammonium compounds for diverse markets and applications.

[[Flame Retardants]][58] [FLAME
RETARDANTS][59]

ACTI-CHEM is an established name in the development and production of **AFLAMMIT^{®}**
environmentally acceptable flame retardant products.

[[Personal Care]][60] [PERSONAL
CARE][61]

ACTI-CHEM's **Microcare^{®}** range includes high purity preservatives and emollients, globally
approved quat and amine conditioning products and silicones for skin and hair care.

# Home
* FortiCulture CoconutAs consumers continue to seek sustainability and safety in their products,
  multifunctional antimicrobials are a clear choice. Inspired by our commitment to sustainable
  solutions, Active Micro Technologies has adopted a Cradle to Cradle approach, using the coconuts
  we source to their fullest to minimize our footprint and maximize skin care benefits. Coconut oil,
  when fractionated into smaller molecules called medium chain triglycerides (MCTs), provides ideal
  fermentation conditions for yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, to unlock the water-soluble
  lipopeptides standardized in FortiCulture Coconut. More than just sustainably sourced, the
  lipopeptides in FortiCulture Coconut perform two key functions: 1) When topically applied,
  lipopeptides signal keratinocytes to release antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), which regulate the
  skin barrier and increase collagen production. 2) Lipopeptides are naturally antimicrobial and
  provide a broad-spectrum fortress for a wide range of formulation applications. Fortify the skin
  barrier and final formulations with FortiCulture Coconut, a formulation-friendly natural
  antimicrobial with cellular anti-aging benefits.[Read More ][51]
* Leucidal® SF Max PowderLeucidal® SF Max Powder embodies the "less is more" philosophy, packing a
  powerful punch in its powdered form. This advanced version of Leucidal® SF Max boasts five times
  the potency of the original, allowing formulators to save precious time while delivering unmatched
  efficacy with a heightened sense of confidence.[Read More][52]
* PHYTOCIDE LICHEN PhytoCide Lichen from Cladonia Rangiferina a unique active rich
  in usnic acid that provides broad-spectrum protection for cosmetic applications with good
  compliancy in anionic systems. Usnic acid has a wide range of biological activity, most notably
  antibacterial activity against plant and human infections, as well as inhibitory effect against
  antibiotic-resistant bacterial strains. With antioxidant capabilities, this new active will also
  help protect the skin from oxidative stress and cell aging.[Read more][53]

## EXPLORE OUR PRODUCT PORTFOLIO BELOW

## THE MODERN PRESERVATION MARKET

The personal care market has opened its eyes to the growing demand for proactive, innovative and
alternative solutions to synthetic preservatives. Manufacturers add preservatives to formulations in
order to control bacterial and fungal growth, extending the shelf-life of these products. However,
many synthetic preservatives are falling from favor with regulators and consumers alike due to
issues like sensitization and other health related concerns. By developing materials exhibiting
cosmetic benefits, Active Micro Technologies has, in turn, created effective and natural
antimicrobials. Now our customers can continue leading the market with their impressive formulations
and innovative applications!

[CONTINUE READING][54]


## ACTIVE MICRO TECHNOLOGIES COMPANY OVERVIEW

In recent years the Personal Care Industry has seen an increased demand for environmentally
conscious and ethically sound products. Consumers’ desire for naturally derived and inspired
products has only grown more pronounced as public awareness of traditional preservation increases.

With a noticeable shift in both formulator preference and consumer attitude, traditional
preservatives (parabens, formaldehyde-donors, thiazolinones, etc.) have found themselves under
scrutiny. Continued market-focus on “carry over” ingredients effecting health and sustainability,
coupled with the booming naturals trend, have slowly ousted conventional preservatives from product
ingredient decks. Active Micro Technologies predicted this trend and is the market leader in
preservation alternatives.

## THE MODERN PRESERVATION MARKET

The personal care market has opened its eyes to the growing demand for proactive, innovative and
alternative solutions to synthetic preservatives. Manufacturers add preservatives to formulations in
order to control bacterial and fungal growth, extending the shelf-life of these products. However,
many synthetic preservatives are falling from favor with regulators and consumers alike due to
issues like sensitization and other health related concerns. By developing materials exhibiting
cosmetic benefits, Active Micro Technologies has, in turn, created effective and natural
antimicrobials. Now our customers can continue leading the market with their impressive formulations
and innovative applications!

## ACTIVE MICRO TECHNOLOGIES COMPANY OVERVIEW

In recent years the Personal Care Industry has seen an increased demand for environmentally
conscious and ethically sound products. Consumers’ desire for naturally derived and inspired
products has only grown more pronounced as public awareness of traditional preservation increases.

With a noticeable shift in both formulator preference and consumer attitude, traditional
preservatives (parabens, formaldehyde-donors, thiazolinones, etc.) have found themselves under
scrutiny. Continued market-focus on “carry over” ingredients effecting health and sustainability,
coupled with the booming naturals trend, have slowly ousted conventional preservatives from product
ingredient decks. Active Micro Technologies predicted this trend and is the market leader in
preservation alternatives.

oder dekorative Kosmetik, Seifen- oder Parfum-Kreationen.

innovative Emulgatoren, milde Tenside, Öle, Pflanzenextrakte, Hydrolate und Pigmente, sowie eine
große Auswahl an Wirkstoffen für jeden Hauttyp.

#### SeaCure™: Advanced Organic Solutions for Seafood Processing

SeaCure™ represents an innovative line of 100% organic, phosphate-free seafood processing aids.
Developed by Arcadia Chemical and preservative, these products effectively replace traditional

#### Laureth-6: Versatile Surfactant for Advanced Formulations

Laureth-6 is a versatile non-ionic surfactant belonging to the lauryl alcohol ethoxylate family.
With its moderate ethoxylation level, it provides excellent emulsification and solubilizing
properties while maintaining balanced water solubility. This surfactant is particularly effective in
personal care and industrial formulations, offering reliable performance as an emulsifier,
solubilizer, and cleansing agent.

Personal Care and Cosmetics

#### Laureth-7: Advanced Surfactant for Modern Formulations

Laureth-7 is a non-ionic surfactant with a higher degree of ethoxylation than Laureth-6, providing
enhanced water solubility and superior emulsification properties. This versatile surfactant excels
in personal care formulations, offering excellent solubilizing capabilities and stable emulsion
formation. Its balanced properties make it particularly valuable in cleansing products and emulsion
systems where enhanced stability and mildness are required.

#### SeaCure™: Advanced Organic Solutions for Seafood Processing

SeaCure™ represents an innovative line of 100% organic, phosphate-free seafood processing aids.
Developed by Arcadia Chemical and preservative, these products effectively replace traditional
phosphate-based solutions like Sodium Tripolyphosphate E451(i), SHMP, and SAPP. The SeaCure™ line
includes specialized formulations for different seafood types (Shrimp, Fish, Lobster) and provides
moisture control through protein stabilization while preventing melanosis and discoloration. Made
with US & EU Food Grade ingredients in a cGMP facility, SeaCure™ products maintain natural nutrient
content, enhance shelf stability, and improve texture and appearance of seafood products.

#### SeaFresh: Advanced Melanosis Control for Premium Shrimp Processing

SeaFresh™ is a specialized blend designed for preventing melanosis (black spot) in shrimp and other
crustaceans. Unlike sulfite treatments, it effectively binds to melanosis-causing enzymes, providing
protection that persists through rinsing, refrigeration, and thawing. Its easy-to-use formulation is
effective at low concentrations, making it an efficient solution for the seafood processing
industry.

#### Alkyl Poly Glucoside: Natural-Based Surfactant for Modern Formulations

Alkyl Poly Glucoside (APG) is a naturally-derived surfactant produced from renewable resources like
glucose and fatty alcohols. This biodegradable compound combines excellent cleaning performance with
environmental sustainability. Its gentle nature and versatility make it ideal for personal care and
household cleaning formulations where both effectiveness and natural origin are valued, particularly
in applications requiring mild, eco-friendly ingredients.

#### Laureth-6: Versatile Surfactant for Advanced Formulations

Laureth-6 is a versatile non-ionic surfactant belonging to the lauryl alcohol ethoxylate family.
With its moderate ethoxylation level, it provides excellent emulsification and solubilizing
properties while maintaining balanced water solubility. This surfactant is particularly effective in
personal care and industrial formulations, offering reliable performance as an emulsifier,
solubilizer, and cleansing agent.

enhanced water solubility and superior emulsification properties. This versatile surfactant excels
in personal care formulations, offering excellent solubilizing capabilities and stable emulsion
formation. Its balanced properties make it particularly valuable in cleansing products and emulsion
systems where enhanced stability and mildness are required.

##### **Arxada is a global industry trailblazer in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our
##### microbial control solutions are the silent protectors you don’t even know exist in your
##### everyday products. **

Wherever there is water, there are harmful microbes—and wherever microbes exist, our solutions help
control them. 

You’ll find our products in your home, from shampoos and dish soap to disinfecting wipes, the paint
on your walls or on your boat, and even in the wood deck or fence surrounding your property.

 

##### Silently protecting - see how our solutions protect the world around you.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

About Us

## Who We Are

Shenzhen Curon Pet Co., Ltd. is based in Shenzhen, China — one of the world's most dynamic
manufacturing hubs. We are a dedicated pet nutrition manufacturer with a clear mission: to create
products that genuinely improve the health and happiness of pets around the globe.

Founded on the principles of quality, transparency, and scientific innovation, Curon Pet has grown
from a focused domestic supplier into a trusted international partner for pet brands, distributors,
and retailers across more than 30 countries.

Our team of nutritionists, food scientists, and quality engineers collaborates closely with clients
to develop products that meet the highest standards of safety and efficacy. We believe that every
pet deserves the best nutrition, and every brand partner deserves a manufacturer they can fully
trust.

Product Portfolio

## Comprehensive Pet Nutrition Solutions

Curon Pet offers a diverse range of **dry and wet pet food, natural treats, functional snacks, and
specialized nutrition formulas** designed to support every stage of a pet's life.

🥩

### Dry Pet Food

Nutritionally balanced kibble formulas for dogs and cats, available in various protein sources
including chicken, salmon, beef, and lamb. Designed for daily feeding and complete nutrition.

🥫

### Wet Pet Food

High-moisture canned and pouch formats providing palatability and hydration. Ideal for picky eaters
and senior pets. Available in pâté, chunks in gravy, and shredded varieties.

🦴

### Natural Treats

Single-ingredient and minimally processed treats crafted from premium natural ingredients. Free from
artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives — perfect for training and rewarding.

💊

### Functional Snacks

Targeted functional treats addressing key health needs: **digestion support, skin & coat health,
joint mobility,** and overall immune wellness — backed by scientifically validated ingredients.

🧪

### Specialized Nutrition Formulas

Veterinary-inspired formulas for life stage management, weight control, sensitive digestion, and
breed-specific needs. Developed in collaboration with pet nutrition experts.

🌿

### Grain-Free & Organic Lines

Clean-label product lines catering to health-conscious pet owners. Grain-free, limited ingredient,
and certified organic options available for private label and OEM programs.

Our Facility

## State-of-the-Art Manufacturing Facility

Our modern production facility in Shenzhen is equipped with advanced food processing technology,
automated production lines, and rigorous quality control systems. Every aspect of our facility is
designed to ensure the highest standards of food safety and product consistency.
* GMP-compliant production environment with full traceability
* Automated filling, sealing, and packaging lines
* On-site laboratory for ingredient and finished product testing
* Cold-chain storage and temperature-controlled processing zones
* Dedicated R&D kitchen for formula development and prototyping
* Annual capacity exceeding 5,000 metric tons of finished product

[Curon Pet Manufacturing Facility - Modern Production Lines]
Why Curon Pet

## Why Choose Us

We combine deep industry expertise, advanced technology, and a genuine passion for pet health to
deliver solutions that give your brand a competitive edge in the global market.

🔬

### Science-Backed Formulas

Every product is developed by our in-house nutrition team using evidence-based ingredient selection
and clinical research insights.

🏭

### Vertically Integrated Production

From raw material sourcing to finished goods, we control every step — ensuring quality, cost
efficiency, and fast turnaround times.
